THESIS STATUS: CONFIRMED
ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE: 80%
OVERNIGHT SUMMARY: Global selloff accelerated with Asian and European markets down 2-5%, while US futures initially bounced but are now fading. VIX spike to 26+ confirms fear escalation. Explosive volatility regime validates bearish setup.

KEY DEVELOPMENTS:
• Shanghai down -4.47%, European markets -3% to -5% showing global contagion
• VIX surged 5.66% overnight, now at 26.34 maintaining elevated fear premium
• Net GEX deeply negative at -618M confirming fragile market structure
• ES futures fading from +0.31% to -0.15%, classic overnight reversal pattern
• Put wall at 640 exactly matches our short strike - critical support level

TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS: HOLD
TRADE NOTES: Position perfectly positioned with put wall at our 640 short strike providing natural support. Current ES at 6624 gives us cushion above breakeven at 652.42. Hold through morning session but monitor 640 level closely for potential profit-taking.

DAY AHEAD RISKS:
• Powell speech or Fed communications could spark relief rally
• Oversold bounce potential given global selloff magnitude
• Options expiration flows tomorrow could create volatility

DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES: 
• Gap down opening likely given futures weakness and global selloff
• Negative GEX environment favors continued downside momentum
• VIX above 26 suggests fear premium will persist through session
• Target initial profit-taking if SPY breaks below 645 convincingly
